title: In Silico Study for Optimizing Intensity and Focality Electrode Configurations for Directional DBS Under Uncertainty Using Metaheuristic L1L1 Method
abstract: arXiv:2506.13452v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Background and Objective: As Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) advances toward directional leads and optimization-based current steering, selecting electrode contact configurations becomes complex. This study formulates configuration selection as an inverse mapping between target activation and electrode currents using metaheuristic L1-norm regularized L1-norm fitting (L1L1). L1L1 incorporates lead-field uncertainty arising from electrode placement, tissue properties, and forward modeling assumptions.   Methods: The framework introduces lead-field perturbations and restricts the controllable domain through a sensitivity-based feasibility criterion within a finite element formulation derived using the Complete Electrode Model. Current distributions were optimized for 8- and 40-contact leads. Performance was evaluated using focused current density, nuisance current density, and their ratio under safety and sparsity constraints.   Resu

translated_title: 基于元启发式L1L1方法在不确定性下优化定向深脑刺激电极配置的强度与聚焦性硅内研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2506.13452v3 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：背景与目标：随着深脑刺激（DBS）向定向导联和基于优化的电流转向发展，选择电极接触配置变得复杂。本研究将配置选择表述为目标激活与电极电流之间的逆映射，使用元启发式L1范数正则化L1范数拟合（L1L1）方法。L1L1方法结合了由电极放置、组织特性和前向建模假设引起的导联场不确定性。方法：该框架引入了导联场扰动，并通过基于灵敏度的可行性准则限制可控域，该准则在基于完整电极模型推导的有限元公式中应用。针对8触点导联和40触点导联优化了电流分布。性能评估使用聚焦电流密度、干扰电流密度及其比值，并考虑安全性和稀疏性约束。结果：
tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于元启发式L1L1方法的新框架，能在考虑电极放置等不确定性下优化定向深脑刺激的电极配置，实现电流聚焦性与安全性的平衡。
en_tdlr: This study proposes a novel metaheuristic L1L1-based framework that optimizes directional DBS electrode configurations under uncertainty from electrode placement, balancing current focality and safety.
